records.jp: はーい、みなさーん
records.en_original: Attention, everyone!
records.en_auxiliary: Attention, everyone!
records.en: Attention, everyone!

records.jp: 宴もたけなわですが、この辺で一旦<CR>締めさせてもらおうと思います
records.en_original: Sorry to interrupt while the party's in full swing, but we have a few words we'd like to say.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry to interrupt while the party's in full swing, but we have a few words we'd like to say.
records.en: Though the party is in full swing,<CR>I'd like to bring it to a close around here.

records.jp: ……ねぇ、こういう時って一本締め？　三本締め？
records.en_original: First, let's all give Ao three cheers! Hip hip—
records.en_auxiliary: First, let's all give Ao three cheers! Hip hip—
records.en: ...Hey, at times like this, do we do one clap or three?

records.jp: いや、おじさんじゃないんだし。<CR>普通に挨拶でいいんじゃない？
records.en_original: What is this, the 1800s? Just give a normal speech!
records.en_auxiliary: What is this, the 1800s? Just give a normal speech!
records.en: We're not middle-aged men.<CR>A normal speech is fine, right?

records.jp: ……えー、今日こうやって歓迎会を開いて<CR>みんなとの思い出を振り返ってみて
records.en_original: Ahem! Esteemed guests, thank you for coming today. This party gave me the opportunity to reflect on our memories here together.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahem! Esteemed guests, thank you for coming today. This party gave me the opportunity to reflect on our memories here together.
records.en: ...Um, holding this welcome party today<CR>and looking back on our memories with everyone...

records.jp: 本当に色んなことがあったなと<CR>改めて思った次第であります
records.en_original: It made me startlingly aware of just how much we have experienced together.
records.en_auxiliary: It made me startlingly aware of just how much we have experienced together.
records.en: made me realize anew<CR>just how many things have happened.

records.jp: まだおじさんっぽいぞー
records.en_original: Is this what you would call a normal speech?
records.en_auxiliary: Is this what you would call a normal speech?
records.en: You still sound like an old man!

records.jp: きららには言われたくない！<CR>……どれもこれもかけがえのない思い出で
records.en_original: That's rich coming from you, Kirara! ...But really, all of these memories are super important to me.
records.en_auxiliary: That's rich coming from you, Kirara! ...But really, all of these memories are super important to me.
records.en: I don't want to hear that from Kirara!<CR>...Every one of them is an irreplaceable memory.

records.jp: 正直に言うと、このままみんなとずっと……
records.en_original: And, well, if I'm being honest, I'd like things to stay like this forever...
records.en_auxiliary: And, well, if I'm being honest, I'd like things to stay like this forever...
records.en: And, well, if I'm being honest, I'd like things to stay like this forever...

records.jp: でも、いつかこの世界にも終わりが来る。<CR>それがいい結末にしろ、悪い結末にしろ……ね
records.en_original: But the end will come either way. Whether it's for better or for worse...
records.en_auxiliary: But the end will come either way. Whether it's for better or for worse...
records.en: But someday this world will end.<CR>Whether that is a happy ending or a sad one...

records.jp: 終わり……
records.en_original: The end...
records.en_auxiliary: The end...
records.en: The end...

records.jp: あたしは、いい結末にしたい。<CR>絶対に……絶対にそうしたい
records.en_original: I want to make sure it's all for the best.
records.en_auxiliary: I want to make sure it's all for the best.
records.en: I want it to have a happy ending.<CR>Absolutely...absolutely.

records.jp: 笑って、またみんなで会えるように……<CR>あたしたちは、できることを精一杯頑張りましょう
records.en_original: Let's keep smiling. I know we'll all meet again. Until then, let's all do our best.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's keep smiling. I know we'll all meet again. Until then, let's all do our best.
records.en: So we can smile and all meet again...<CR>let us each do everything we can.

records.jp: じゃ、次は愛央
records.en_original: Right, next up is Ao!
records.en_auxiliary: Right, next up is Ao!
records.en: Right, next up is Ao!

records.jp: え？　今ので締まってなかった？
records.en_original: Wait, was that not the closing speech?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, was that not the closing speech?
records.en: Wait, was that not the closing speech?

records.jp: いやぁ、やっぱここはリーダーに締めてもらわないと
records.en_original: Nah, I thought I should leave that to our leader!
records.en_auxiliary: Nah, I thought I should leave that to our leader!
records.en: No, our leader has to close things out.

records.jp: ええ～、急に振られても……
records.en_original: But I haven't prepared anything!
records.en_auxiliary: But I haven't prepared anything!
records.en: What? Even if you spring it on me...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、がんばれ
records.en_original: You can do it, Ao!
records.en_auxiliary: You can do it, Ao!
records.en: You can do it, Ao-chan!

records.jp: えっと、何話したらいいかわかんないですけど<CR>とりあえず……
records.en_original: Um, well, I don't really know what to say, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Um, well, I don't really know what to say, but...
records.en: Um, I don't know what to say,<CR>but for now...

records.jp: みんなありがとう！
records.en_original: Thank you all!
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you all!
records.en: Thank you all!

records.jp: あはは、ざっくりしすぎだよ～
records.en_original: Ahaha, short and sweet.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, short and sweet.
records.en: Ahaha, short and sweet.

records.jp: 星崎さんらしいっちゃらしいのかもね
records.en_original: Well, that's our Hoshizaki.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, that's our Hoshizaki.
records.en: Well, that's our Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 私たちも感謝してるよ。<CR>ここまでみんなを引っ張ってくれたこと
records.en_original: We're grateful too, Ao. Thank you for always pushing us forward.
records.en_auxiliary: We're grateful too, Ao. Thank you for always pushing us forward.
records.en: We're grateful too.<CR>For leading everyone this far.

records.jp: 引っ張るだけじゃなくて、私たち一人一人のことを<CR>気遣ってくれてることもね
records.en_original: And not only that, thank you for always looking out for each one of us.
records.en_auxiliary: And not only that, thank you for always looking out for each one of us.
records.en: And not only leading us,<CR>but caring about each and every one of us.

records.jp: 何かあった時に真っ先に励ましてくれるのも、<CR>愛央ちゃんだよね！
records.en_original: Yeah, you're always the first to encourage us whenever something goes wrong!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, you're always the first to encourage us whenever something goes wrong!
records.en: You're always the first to encourage us<CR>when something happens, Ao-chan!

records.jp: 時には一緒にふざけてくれたりもする。<CR>愛央は優しい
records.en_original: But you also make time to goof off with us too. You are kind, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: But you also make time to goof off with us too. You are kind, Ao.
records.en: Sometimes you also fool around with us.<CR>Ao is kind.

records.jp: はい、優しいです。<CR>こんな私にも仲間として接してくださいました
records.en_original: Yes, you truly are kind. You welcomed even someone like me into the group. Thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, you truly are kind. You welcomed even someone like me into the group. Thank you.
records.en: Yes, you are kind.<CR>You treated even someone like me as one of your companions.

records.jp: きっと、誰よりもこの世界のこと……<CR>わたしたちのことを考えてくれているんですよね
records.en_original: You care more about this world...and about us...than anyone else.
records.en_auxiliary: You care more about this world...and about us...than anyone else.
records.en: You surely think about this world...<CR>and about us more than anyone else.

records.jp: どうせ、今も悩んでるんでしょ
records.en_original: So much so that I bet you're worrying even now.
records.en_auxiliary: So much so that I bet you're worrying even now.
records.en: You're worrying even now, aren't you?

records.jp: 普段大雑把なくせに、そういうところだけ<CR>余計な気回すんだから
records.en_original: Although you look easygoing and carefree on the outside, you really do worry a lot.
records.en_auxiliary: Although you look easygoing and carefree on the outside, you really do worry a lot.
records.en: You're normally so rough-and-ready,<CR>but only with things like this do you worry needlessly.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんが選んだことなら、<CR>わたしたち受け止めるよ
records.en_original: But you don't need to, Ao. We're always behind you.
records.en_auxiliary: But you don't need to, Ao. We're always behind you.
records.en: Whatever Ao-chan chooses,<CR>we'll accept it.

records.jp: ちょっと、どうしたのみんな？
records.en_original: What's gotten into all of you...?
records.en_auxiliary: What's gotten into all of you...?
records.en: What's gotten into all of you...?

records.jp: これが言いたくて開いたとこもあるから。<CR>この歓迎会
records.en_original: Part of the reason we had this party was to let you know how we felt.
records.en_auxiliary: Part of the reason we had this party was to let you know how we felt.
records.en: Part of the reason we held this welcome party<CR>was to tell you this.

records.jp: そっか……
records.en_original: I see...
records.en_auxiliary: I see...
records.en: I see...

records.jp: （私が悩んでること、みんなにバレバレだったんだ）
records.en_original: (Everyone knows I've been worrying about something...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Everyone knows I've been worrying about something...)
records.en: (Everyone knows I've been worrying about something...)

records.jp: （だからこころも、１日中ずっと……）
records.en_original: (That's why Kokoro spent the whole day hanging out with me...)
records.en_auxiliary: (That's why Kokoro spent the whole day hanging out with me...)
records.en: (That's why Kokoro spent the whole day hanging out with me...)

records.jp: （……そうだ、私は一人じゃない）
records.en_original: (That's right... I'm not alone.)
records.en_auxiliary: (That's right... I'm not alone.)
records.en: (That's right... I'm not alone.)

records.jp: （悩んだらみんなと乗り越える。<CR>この世界で、それを教えてもらった）
records.en_original: (No matter what it is, we can all get through it together. That's what I learned in my time here.)
records.en_auxiliary: (No matter what it is, we can all get through it together. That's what I learned in my time here.)
records.en: (When I worry, we overcome it together.<CR>This world taught me that.)

records.jp: （成功するかも分からない……<CR>だからって、ひとりで考えてちゃダメなんだ）
records.en_original: (I don't even know if this will work yet...but that's exactly why I shouldn't worry about it alone.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I don't even know if this will work yet...but that's exactly why I shouldn't worry about it alone.)
records.en: (I don't even know whether it will succeed...<CR>but that does not mean I should think about it alone.)

records.jp: （私には、みんながいる）
records.en_original: (I still have everyone else.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I still have everyone else.)
records.en: (I have everyone.)

records.jp: ……みんな
records.en_original: Everyone...
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone...
records.en: Everyone...

records.jp: 明日改めて話したいことがある
records.en_original: I have something else I'd like to talk to you about tomorrow.
records.en_auxiliary: I have something else I'd like to talk to you about tomorrow.
records.en: I have something else I'd like to talk to you about tomorrow.

records.jp: うん。待ってる
records.en_original: Of course. We'll be waiting.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course. We'll be waiting.
records.en: Of course. We'll be waiting.
